    - paragraph: Add a card to Apple Wallet.
    - heading "Apple Pay" [level=1]

    - img "A hand holding an iPhone, front, displays a Chase Sapphire Reserve credit card, a blue checkmark indicates \"Done\""
    - text: Apple Pay is your debit or credit card, just on your iPhone. Earn the same benefits and rewards, with the reliable security of your Apple device — and your purchases are protected by Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode. Simply double-click and tap to pay anywhere there’s a Contactless payment symbol in a store or Apple Pay symbol online. For everything from groceries to vacations, Apple Pay is designed so only you can pay.

    - heading "Privacy and Security" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Protection you can bank on.
    - paragraph: Apple Pay combines the payment protections you expect with the Apple security features you love. Your transactions are protected by Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode, and they use a device‑specific number instead of your actual card number, so Apple Pay is more secure than tapping your physical card.
    - list "privacy and security gallery":
      - listitem:
        - heading "Authorize payments securely." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Apple Pay is designed so only you can pay — your transactions are protected by Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode. And you get the same fraud protections as with your physical card.
        - img "Face ID symbol"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Your actual card number is never shared." [level=3]
        - paragraph: With device‑specific tokenization, Apple Pay uses a unique code for every purchase. This keeps your actual card number hidden from merchants in stores, online, and in apps to help reduce card fraud.
        - img "A stack of cards in Apple Wallet, showing only the last four digits of the front card"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Lost your device? Lock it down." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Use Find My to activate Lost Mode, which instantly suspends Apple Pay and displays a message with your contact information on your device. If it’s truly lost, you can remotely erase your payment cards.
        - img "Find My app chiclet"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Your transactions are not for sale." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Apple doesn’t sell your transaction data for third‑party marketing or advertising.
        - img "A raised hand icon over a blurred list of transactions"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Keep your actual card number on lock." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Only you and your bank or card issuer know your actual card number. It’s encrypted on your Apple devices and iCloud Keychain, where Apple can’t see it.
        - img "A payment card icon with a padlock icon overlay"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous item, Privacy and Security gallery" [disabled]:

      - listitem:

    - heading "Acceptance" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Pay practically anywhere.
    - paragraph: Use Apple Pay anywhere there’s a Contactless payment symbol in stores and Apple Pay symbol online or in apps — and even for transit. So whether you pay at checkout with your iPhone in person or at home with your Mac, you’ll never have to reach for your wallet.
    - img "iPhone, front, displaying an Apple Pay payment sheet, with a Chase debit card selected, shipping and delivery details, and a \"Confirm with Side Button\" prompt"
    - img "iPhone tapping a contactless reader, front, displaying a Face ID symbol, and a Bank of America debit card"
    - img "iPhone, front, displaying a Tap transit card, with a $60.75 stored value, an \"Add Money\" button, and a list of recent transit transactions"
    - list "acceptance gallery":
      - listitem:
        - heading "Check out across your Apple devices." [level=3]
        - paragraph: You can use Apple Pay on your iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro. So when you’re out for a run — or just ordering food from the couch — you have an easy way to pay.
        - 'img "Apple devices compatible with Apple Pay, each with a blue checkmark: iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac, iPad, Apple Vision Pro"'
      - listitem:
        - heading "The symbol seals the deal." [level=3]
        - paragraph: You can use Apple Pay anywhere that accepts contactless payments at the register in stores. Double‑click. Tap. Done.
        - img "Apple Watch, front, displaying a Chase Sapphire credit card, with a \"Double Click to Pay\" prompt, held near a contactless payment reader"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Pay confidently online and in apps." [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: For anything from clothes to electronics, you can shop across millions of websites and apps. Select the Apple Pay button at checkout, review and edit payment and shipping details, confirm your purchase with Face ID, and track your order with Apple Intelligence.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 1":
              - /url: "#footnote-1"
              - text: "1"
        - img "iPhone, front, displaying an online order summary, coupon and gift card options, and a \"Check out with Apple Pay\" button"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Fly through checkout in Safari." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Shopping online in Safari on your Mac makes checking out a breeze. Select the Apple Pay button at checkout, and your default card, shipping, billing, and contact details appear in one view for you to review or change. To confirm and pay, authenticate your purchase with Touch ID or your password. It’s that simple.
        - img "MacBook, front, displaying an Apple Pay payment sheet, in Safari, with a Bank of America debit card, shipping and delivery details, and a \"Pay with Touch ID\" prompt"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Apple Pay works in other browsers, too." [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: You can also use Apple Pay in third‑party browsers with participating merchants. Just select Apple Pay at checkout, scan the QR code with your iPhone, review your payment and order details, and confirm your purchase.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 2":
              - /url: "#footnote-2"
              - text: "2"
        - img "MacBook, front, a webpage in Safari, with an Apple Pay message showing a QR code and the prompt \"Scan Code with iPhone\""
      - listitem:
        - heading "Pay the fare with a tap." [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: In eligible cities worldwide, you can use Apple Pay for public transportation.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 3":
              - /url: "#footnote-3"
              - text: "3"
          - text: With Express Mode, just hold your iPhone or Apple Watch to the Contactless Symbol on the reader without even unlocking your device, and you’re ready to ride.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 4":
              - /url: "#footnote-4"
              - text: "4"
        - img "A bus icon, a subway train icon, and a ferry boat icon."
        - link "Learn more about Apple Pay for Transit":
          - /url: https://learn.wallet.apple/transit
      - listitem:
        - heading "Works locally, worldwide." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Apple Pay works around the world, anywhere contactless payments are accepted. So you can pay with just your phone, even when you’re far from home.
        - img "Globe icon, white, blue background"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous item, Acceptance gallery" [disabled]:

    - heading "Ways to Pay" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Big purchase? You’ve got shoptions.
    - paragraph:
      - text: Pay in full or over time with an eligible card or pay‑later provider at checkout — both online and in stores.
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 5":
          - /url: "#footnote-5"
          - text: "5"
      - text: You can also use your card’s rewards online.
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 6":
          - /url: "#footnote-6"
          - text: "6"
      - text: And you can check your card balance and transaction history right in Apple Wallet.
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 7":
          - /url: "#footnote-7"
          - text: "7"
      - text: So whether you’re booking a trip with points or splurging on your dream bag, you have the option to pay exactly how you want.
